verdict.rationale: LangGraph's README explicitly touts LangSmith integration for 'deep visibility into complex agent behavior with visualization tools that trace execution paths, capture state transitions, and provide detailed runtime metrics,' directly matching the story of tracing LLM/tool calls in an observability UI. Evidence is first-party only, with no independent hands-on confirmation of the tracing UI's granularity or reliability. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the LangSmith trace UI, and documentation detail on tool-call-level tracing specifics.
